No sound: microphone permission denied or the device does not allow internal audio capture.
Some phones close apps in the background to save battery and the cast stops. These three steps prevent it.
ColorOS (OPPO, realme, OnePlus): allow «Auto launch» and set battery to «Allow background activity». Reinstalling the app resets these settings.
MIUI / HyperOS (Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO): enable «Autostart» and set Battery saver to «No restrictions».
One UI (Samsung): in Battery, set the app to «Unrestricted» and remove it from «Sleeping apps».
Allow the app to run in the background without battery restrictions.
2. Allow auto launch (if your phone has it)
This browser is for websites (for example twitch.tv). Open the site, start the video and it will show up below, ready to send.
Is the video in another app? HPlay cannot see inside other apps. Open HPlay Receiver on the PC or TV and use that app\'s own cast/TV button. If it has none, use «Mirror screen».
Asking the TV to open the app…
The TV opened the official app. You can turn off your phone.
That app is not installed on the TV.
The TV did not answer. Is the HPlay receiver open?
This device cannot open apps. Use an HPlay receiver (TV or PC), a Roku or a TV with DIAL (YouTube/Netflix).

Waiting. Leave the address below open on the TV browser: videos you send from HPlay, and from apps with a DLNA cast button (Play Shots…) to «HPlay · TV browser», will play there.

Shows the video addresses that other apps hand to HPlay (DLNA cast button, «Share», «Open with») and the ones the HPlay browser loads. Android does not let one app read what another app is playing: if an app does not hand over the address, HPlay cannot see it.
In the other app press its cast/DLNA button and choose «HPlay · Detector». Nothing plays: the address and its data appear below, ready to copy, check or send.

Lists the domains apps look up and, when Android says so, which app. Only DNS goes through the VPN. It never reveals the video\'s address: HTTPS/QUIC hide the path, and apps with their own DNS or strict private DNS are not seen.
Nothing yet. Send to «HPlay · Detector» from a DLNA app, use «Share» or «Open with» → HPlay, or play a video in the HPlay browser.
Available only with the received headers (Referer/Cookie/token)
DLNA cannot carry Referer or cookies: if the server requires them, only the sender app can play it.
Domains seen by DNS (not video addresses)
Start the DNS monitor to see them.

Android closed the VPN request without showing it. This happens when another app (for example NoAds) is set as «Always-on VPN» in Android settings, even if you turned it off inside that app. Only one VPN can run at a time: open VPN settings, tap the gear next to that app and turn off «Always-on VPN». The DLNA receiver does not need the VPN.
